notes: RPCS3 (PlayStation 3): the official RPCS3/rpcs3-binaries-linux-arm64 AppImage (linuxdeploy), mounted; usr/bin/rpcs3 runs directly (RUNPATH $ORIGIN/../lib, qt.conf). It bundles no Vulkan loader or Mesa, so it runs on the image's Turnip.
--no-gui boots the game without the main window and quits when the game stops; --fullscreen (only valid with --no-gui) fills the panel.
A ROM is a decrypted disc folder (PS3_GAME/USRDIR/EBOOT.BIN) or an .iso (a redump .iso needs its .dkey beside it).

A .psn ROM is a stub RetroForge wrote when it installed a PSN .pkg (plan psn-pkg): its first line is the title id, booted as %RPCS3_GAMEID%:<id> so RPCS3 finds the installed game (dev_hdd0/game/<id>) through its own VFS, wherever vfs.yml puts dev_hdd0.

Firmware: the player's ~/bios/PS3UPDAT.PUP, installed once by install (--headless --installfw has no dialogs and exits 0 even on failure, so success is dev_flash's version.txt). Without it a game is not started: RPCS3 would only show a fatal error box.
gui_args: Big Picture Mode, RPCS3's pad-driven game grid over ~/roms/ps3 (vfs.yml). Never --no-gui there: with no game it only shows an error box.

SDL_NO_SIGNAL_HANDLERS=1: RPCS3's own SDL3 otherwise catches SIGTERM and turns it into an SDL quit event RPCS3 never reads (its loop is Qt's), so OpenGamepadUI's Exit did nothing (HW 2026-10-07, Pocket FIT: SigCgt had SIGTERM). With the hint SIGTERM keeps its default action and ends RPCS3 at once (RPCS3 saves nothing on exit anyway).
